03 / PART OF YOUR WORKFLOW

Feels at home.
Works with your tools.

On your Mac.

Run Apple’s on-device model with native SwiftUI controls. Your suites and evidence stay in a local workspace.

Native SwiftUI · Apple silicon

With your agent.

The built-in MCP server lets your coding agent manage suites and run evaluations. Review the same results in the app.

Connect an agent

Inside your app.

Evaluate real Swift feature closures on a paired iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Test the behaviour your users actually experience.

Read the integration guide

Need another model? Connect compatible Core AI models or your own HTTP provider. Remote providers and judges use their configured services.
